backward.definition:
a. directed or facing toward the back or rear
a. (used of temperament or behavior) marked by a retiring nature
s. retarded in intellectual development
s. having made less than normal progress
backward.translation:
adv. 向后地, 相反地
a. 向后的, 相反的
[计] 倒推

backward classes.translation: 落后阶级, 落后种姓（印度各省当局建议在教育和就业方面给予优惠）

backward compatibility.translation:
向后兼容
[计] 向后兼容

backward counter.translation: [计] 减法计数器, 反向计数器

backward echo.translation: [计] 反向回答, 反向回打

backward error.translation: [计] 后向误差, 反向错误

backward feed.translation: [化] 逆流加料; 逆向进料

backward flow.translation: [机] 逆流, 对流, 反流

backward option.translation: [计] 反向选择, 后向选择

backward pointer.translation: [计] 反向指针, 反向指示字

backward reasoning.translation:
[计] 向后推理, 反向推理
[化] 反向推理

backward recovery.translation: [计] 逆向恢复, 向后恢复

backward tracing.translation: [计] 向后追踪, 自下而上追踪, 倒逆追踪

backward-bladed impeller.translation: [化] 后弯叶轮; 后弯叶片叶轮

backward-compatible.translation: adj. 反向兼容，逆向相容

backward-forward counter.translation: [计] 双向计数器; 正反向计算器

backward-looking.translation: a. 回顾过去的; 保守的; 退缩的; 向后看的

backwardation.definition:
n. The seller's postponement of delivery of stock or
   shares, with the consent of the buyer, upon payment of a premium to the
   latter; -- also, the premium so paid. See Contango.
backwardation.translation:
n. 延期交割费
[经] (证券)交割延期费

backwardly.definition:
adv. Reluctantly; slowly; aversely.
adv. Perversely; ill.
backwardly.translation: adv. (无比较级)向后, 相反, 倒, 回顾, 倒向, 落后, 进展缓慢, 迟疑, 智力差, 畏缩

backwardness.definition: n lack of normal development of intellectual capacities
backwardness.translation:
n. (无比较级)向后, 相反, 倒, 回顾, 倒向, 落后, 进展缓慢, 迟疑, 智力差, 畏缩
[医] 精神[发育]迟缓

backwards.definition:
r at or to or toward the back or rear
r in a manner or order or direction the reverse of normal

backwash.definition:
n the flow of air that is driven backwards by an aircraft propeller
n the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)
n the wave that spreads behind a boat as it moves forward
backwash.translation:
n. (划桨引起的)反流, 激流区, 反响
[机] 逆吹

backwashed.definition:
past tense of backwash
n the flow of air that is driven backwards by an aircraft propeller
n the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)
n the wave that spreads behind a boat as it moves forward
backwashed.translation:
(backwash 的过去时) n. (划桨引起的)反流, 激流区, 反响
[机] 逆吹

backwasher.translation: [机] 梳毛纺纱之间洗净工作

backwashing.definition:
-ing form of backwash
n the flow of air that is driven backwards by an aircraft propeller
n the consequences of an event (especially a catastrophic event)
n the wave that spreads behind a boat as it moves forward
backwashing.translation:
(backwash 的现在分词) n. (划桨引起的)反流, 激流区, 反响
[机] 逆吹

backwater.definition:
n. a body of water that was created by a flood or tide or by being held or forced back by a dam
n. a place or condition in which no development or progress is occurring
backwater.translation: n. 死水, 滞水, 停滞, 回水

backwaters.definition:
n. a body of water that was created by a flood or tide or by being held or forced back by a dam
n. a place or condition in which no development or progress is occurring
backwaters.translation: n. 死水( backwater的复数形式 ); 滞水; 闭塞的地方; 不受外界事件或新思想影响的地方

backwood.translation: n. 未开垦地, (偏僻的森林地带)

backwoods.definition: n. a remote and undeveloped area

backwoodsman.definition: n a man who lives on the frontier
backwoodsman.translation: n. 住在边远地区的人

backwoodsmen.translation: n. 极少参加投票的上议院议员, 很少参加政治活动的上议院议员( backwoodsman的名词复数 ); 边远落后地区的居民

backwrap.translation: n. 背部装拉链的套衫(或裙子)
